description: Untimed per-group backward energy profile on E100 at 32 px / bs 1024 (static graphs, warmed in build), with no change to the scored path. Use CUDA events plus torch.profiler over 20 steps for the full step and for the E116 detached variant. Attribute backward kernel time to stem, group 1, group 2, group 3 and the head (conv dgrad/wgrad, BN/GELU backward reductions and applies). Record bytes read and written per BN/GELU backward kernel and NVML energy per step. Also read the logged cuDNN kernel tile shapes for the group-1 convs, which is the free first step of H2.21.2. For the scored row, rerun the current tip unchanged (an extra distinct gate sample).
